SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Bubbling Well REGISTRY
846
Date 16th September 40.

REPORT

Subject Traffic in "estern Area closed by Japanese Military
Authorities.

Made by. D.C.698 Nagamuna Forwarded by. Evershed C/Inspector I/c.

Sir;

On instructions of C. I. McFarlane, O. i/c of
Bubbling Well Stn., the undersigned communicated
with Lieut. Komori of the Japanese Military Headquarters
at 8.30 a.m. 16-9-40, and ascertained that all traffic
of various roads at the Railway Crossing will be closed
from 8.30 a.m. 16-9-40 until Major-General Shimizu, the
Aid De Camp has passed in a South bound train, which
will leave the North Railway Station at 8.30 a.m.
16-9-40.

Lieut. Komori further informed the undersigned
that shooting practice will take place at Hungjao Air
drome from 16-9-40 to 20-9-40, and all traffic West of
Monument Road will be closed from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
on the above mentioned dates for the purpose of
preventing accidents.

Sir,

Yours obediently
D. S. 693

Sir;

These enquiries were made as a result of the
following telephone message recorded at 7.15 p.m.
15-9-40:-

"From Officer on duty, American Consulate.
Reporting that he had been informed by
American residents that the Western district
(West of the railway) was being closed to
traffic by the Japanese Military on the
16-9-40. Entered by C.I. Hunnings.
D.I.

（印：CHECKED BY (C.B.) REGISTRY DATE 18/9/40）

报告

事由：日军当局封闭西区交通事宜。

呈报人：巡官 698 长宗（Nagamuna，音译） 转呈人：埃弗谢德（Evershed） 代理督察长。

先生：

奉静安寺捕房主管督察麦克法兰（McFarlane）之命，卑职于1940年9月16日上午8时30分与日本军方总部的小森（Komori，音译）中尉取得联系，获悉自1940年9月16日上午8时30分起，铁路道口各条道路的所有交通将予以封闭，直至清水（Shimizu）少将副官乘坐南行列车通过为止，该列车将于1940年9月16日上午8时30分从北站开出。

小森中尉进一步告知卑职，虹桥机场将于1940年9月16日至9月20日进行射击演习，为防止发生事故，在上述日期的上午9时至下午6时期间，纪念碑路以西的所有交通将予以封闭。

先生，

您忠顺的仆人
D. S. 693

先生；

此次查询系因记录了以下于1940年9月15日下午7时15分收到的电话留言所致：-

“来自美国领事馆值班官员。
报告称，据美国居民告知，
日军将于1940年9月16日
对西区（铁路以西）实施
交通管制。由首席督察亨宁斯（Hunnings）录入。
副督察。”

（印：登记处核对 (C.B.) 日期 1940年9月18日）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY 8496 Training Dept. D. Divisions Date September 2nd 40.）
REPORT
Subject. Escort to Cadets of the Japanese Naval Training Squadron when
travelling the foreign area south of the Soochow Creek.
Made by I.S. 761 T. Yamaguchi Forwarded by [签名] Officer i/c.

D. C. DIVISIONS
Information
A. J. Samson
Ac.
6/9

Sir,
I beg to report that on September 5th, 1940 the under-
signed together with P.P.C. 703 S. Sato using motor-cycle
No. 10 escorted Cadets of the Japanese Naval Training
Squadron who was travelling foreign area South of the
Soochow Creek in 4 motor cars and 7 motor busses as
follows :-

11.10 a.m. Information re the above escort was received by
5-9-1940. Inspt. Tetstall from P.A. to D.C. (Divisions).

12.45 p.m. The escorting party assembled at North end of
5-9-1940. the Garden Bridge.

1.20 p.m. The escort started from the above place and pro-
ceeded to the corner of Avenue Haig and Fockhill
Avenue via Garden Bridge, The Bund, Nanking,
Bubbling Well, Avenue Haig, Yu Yuen Roads to
Jessfield Park and back to Edinburgh, Avenue
Haig.

（批：FILE 1/4）

1.55 p.m. Arrived at the above corner then party went into
French Concession along Avenue Joffre and escor-
ting party proceeded to the corner of The Bund
and Avenue Edward VII and awaited arrival of
party from the French Concession.

2.10 p.m. Party of the Cadets re entered the Settlement
from the above corner and was escorted to the
North end of the Garden Bridge via The Bund and
Garden Bridge.

报告
事由：日本海军训练支队学员在苏州河以南外侨区域通行时的护卫情况。
呈报人：实习巡官 761 T. 山口（Yamaguchi） 转呈人：[签名] 主管警官。

分区副警务总监
信息
A. J. 萨姆森（Samson）
代理
9月6日

先生，
卑职谨此报告，1940年9月5日，卑职会同警员 703 S. 佐藤（Sato），使用10号摩托车，为日本海军训练支队的学员提供护卫，该队乘坐4辆汽车和7辆公共汽车在苏州河以南的外侨区域通行，具体情况如下：-

1940年9月5日 上午11时10分。从警务助理处收到关于上述护卫的信息，转至分区副警务总监。泰茨托尔（Tetstall，音译）督察。

1940年9月5日 下午12时45分。护卫队在花园桥北端集合。

下午1时20分。护卫队从上述地点出发，经花园桥、外滩、南京路、静安寺路、海格路、愚园路前往兆丰公园，然后返回爱丁堡路、海格路，抵达海格路与福克斯希尔路（Fockhill Avenue，音译）的拐角处。

（批注：归档 1/4）

下午1时55分。抵达上述拐角处，随后该队沿霞飞路进入法租界，护卫队则前往外滩与爱德华七世大道的拐角处，等待从法租界出来的队伍。

下午2时10分。学员队伍从上述拐角处重新进入租界，经外滩和花园桥被护送至花园桥北端。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 31 Aug 1940）

INDEXED BY
(S.S.) REGISTRY
DATE 1/9/40

（手写：lwk 31/8）

The Japanese Navy training squadron,
comprising H.I.J.M.S. Katori and H.I.J.M.S. Kashima
under the command of Vice-Admiral Mitsuyoshi Shimizu,
is scheduled to visit Shanghai on September 2. The
former, the flagship of Vice-Admiral Shimizu, will
moor at the N.Y.K. Hongkew Wharf, North Yangtse Road,
while the latter will be tied to No.3 and 4 buoys
and will remain in Shanghai until September 6.

During their sojourn in this city, a party
of cadets from the ships will visit the foreign area
South of the Soochow Creek on September 4, crossing
Szechuen Road Bridge between 1.30 p.m. and 2 p.m.
and will traverse the following roads in 10 buses
and 4 motor cars:-

North Szechuen, Szechuen Road Bridge, Soochow,
the Bund, Nanking, Bubbling Well, Great Western, Avenue
Joffre, Boulevard de Montigny, Edward VII Roads, the
Bund and Garden Bridge.

Another party of cadets will visit the foreign
area at the same time on September 5 and traverse the
same roads.

Two parties of petty officers of the squadron
will also visit this area, one party on September 3
and the other on September 4, between 1.30 p.m. and
2 p.m., and traverse along the above mentioned roads in
10 motor trucks.

The Japanese Naval authorities stated that no
special escort by the Municipal Police on the occassion
of their visits is required.

D. C. (Special Branch)
（签名：K. Kamashita）
D S.

日本海军训练支队，由香取号（H.I.J.M.S. Katori）和鹿岛号（H.I.J.M.S. Kashima）组成，在清水光义（Mitsuyoshi Shimizu）中将指挥下，定于9月2日访问上海。前者为清水中将的旗舰，将停泊在北杨树浦路日本邮船会社虹口码头，后者将系泊于3号和4号浮筒，并将在上海停留至9月6日。

在该队逗留本市期间，舰上学员代表团将于9月4日访问苏州河以南的外侨区域，于下午1时30分至2时之间穿过四川路桥，并将乘坐10辆公共汽车和4辆汽车经过以下道路：-

北四川路、四川路桥、苏州路、外滩、南京路、静安寺路、大西路、霞飞路、蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）、爱德华七世路、外滩和花园桥。

另一批学员将于9月5日同一时间访问该外侨区域，并经过相同的道路。

该支队的两批士官也将访问该区域，一批于9月3日，另一批于9月4日，时间在下午1时30分至2时之间，并将乘坐10辆卡车沿上述道路行驶。

日本海军当局表示，在其访问期间无需工部局警务处提供特别护卫。

（签名：K. 下田）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 23 AUG. 1940）

The training ship "Shintoku Maru" of the
Kobe Higher Mercantile Marine School is scheduled to
arrive in Shanghai from Nagasaki at 11 a.m. August 22
and will moor at the China Merchant Steamship
Navigation Company's Central Wharf. Schedule of
the cadets during their sojourn in Shanghai is
as follows :-

August 23. During in the early morning, the
cadets will visit the Japanese Consulate,
Headquarters of the Japanese fleet and other
Government offices and then proceed to the
Kiangnan Dock, Nantao, by boat. At about 10.30 a.m.
they will leave the dock yards by buses and traverse
the foreign area by way of Arsenal, Chun Wha, the
French Bund, Avenue Edward VII, Avenue Joffre, Avenue
Haig and Yu Yuen Roads to Jessfield Park, and then
Yu Yuen, Bubbling Well, Nanking Roads, The Bund and
Garden Bridge to the Headquarters of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party, Kiangwan Road.

At 2 p.m. they will visit the Shanghai
Shinto Shrine, Kiangwan Road, and thereafter will
inspect former war zone in Chapei and Civic Centre.

At 7 p.m. they will attend a dinner party
to be held in the Astor House Hotel by members of
the local Ocean society and other persons interested.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 23 AUG. 1940 (DIVISIONAL)）

August 24. 8 a.m. leave for Nanking by train.

8月23日。清晨，学员将访问日本领事馆、日本舰队司令部及其他政府机构，然后乘船前往南市江南造船厂。上午10时30分左右，他们将乘公共汽车离开船厂，经由兵工厂、春华路、法外滩、爱德华七世大道、霞飞路、海格路和愚园路前往兆丰公园，然后经愚园路、静安寺路、南京路、外滩和花园桥前往江湾路日本海军陆战队司令部。

晚上7时，他们将参加由当地海洋会成员及其他相关人士在礼查饭店举行的晚宴。

Subject A visit to Nantao by Japanese Naval Officers and Cadets,
passing through the Foreign Settlements.
Made by D.P.S. Mizomchi, Forwarded by C. Crawford D.

Some 500 Japanese naval officers and cadets
of the Imperiel Japanese Naval Training Squadron,
which is under the command of Vice-Admiral Sawamoto,
visited Nantao in 15 motor buses, passing through
the International Settlement and the French
Concession en route.

The party travelled by way of Garden Bridge,
The Bund, Nanking Road, Bubbling Well Road, Seymour
Road and the French Concession, and entered Nantao
between 7 a.m. and 7.25 a.m. August 25. During the
time that the Japanese were passing through the
International Settlement and the French Concession,
special precautionary measures were adopted by the
S.M.P. and the French Concession Police.

At 10 a.m. same date, the party returned
to their ships on the Whangpoo River by launches.

No untoward incident occurred.

North side of the sentry box situated on the West side

Black Japanese military hat, black jacket,
white trousers and long black leather
Wellington boots.
Further enquiries were made along the bridges
in Hongkew district about 8.30 a.m. when it was learned
that there were three Chinese in similar uniform on
either side of the Garden Bridge with the J.N.L.Party and,
the four seen at Szechuen Road Bridge had split up into two
on each side of it.

arms with the following written in Chinese characters
"Apprentice to the Naval Diligence Service Group (学徒海军
勤劳奉仕队).
The Chinese on the Garden Bridge were seen to
search pedestrians coming North of the Creek.

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

NOV 21 1938

Japanese Training Ships
Here Today
Cadets to Make Tour of
Local Battlefields

Future Admirals of Japan will be
given a first-hand glimpse of the
Shanghai and Nanking war areas
when 321 cadets of the Japanese naval
training squadron arrive here this
afternoon on board the veteran
cruisers, Iwate and Yakumo, a Jap-
anese naval spokesman announced
yesterday.
Flying the flag of Vice-Admiral
Umataro Tanimoto, who commanded
a Japanese fleet last August at the
start of the hostilities in Shanghai.
the squadron will make port at 3.30
o'clock.
The cadets, of whom 220 are from
the Naval Academy, 76 from the
Naval Engineering School and 25
from the Naval Paymaster's School,
will leave on a tour of the battle
areas starting tomorrow. Officers and
cadets will meet newspaper repre-
sentatives aboard one of the ships at
4.15 o'clock following the exchange
of official courtesies.
Vice-Admiral Tanimoto will be the
guest of honour Thursday at a
banquet at the Astor House Hotel.
The commandant will be host at a
reception on board the flagship,
Iwate prior to leaving for Formosa
at 3 o'clock on Friday afternoon.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，

1938年11月21日

日本练习舰
今日抵沪
学员将巡视
当地战场

一位日本海军发言人昨日宣布，当日本海军练习舰队的321名学员今天下午乘坐老牌巡洋舰“磐手”号和“八云”号抵达此处时，未来的日本海军上将们将得以 firsthand [第一手] 窥见上海和南京战区。
该舰队悬挂着谷本（Umataro Tanimoto）中将的旗帜，谷本中将曾于去年8月上海战事开始时指挥一支日本舰队，该舰队将于3时30分进港。
这些学员中，220人来自海军兵学校，76人来自海军机关学校，25人来自海军经理学校，他们将于明天开始巡视战区。在交换官方礼节后，军官和学员将于4时15分在其中一艘舰船上会见新闻界代表。
谷本中将将是周四在华懋饭店（Astor House Hotel）举行的宴会上的主宾。在周五下午3时启程前往台湾之前，司令官将在旗舰“磐手”号上举行招待会。

"Yakumo" under the command of Vice-Admiral U. Tanimoto left
Shanghai for Formosa at 2 p.m. November 25, 1938.
    No untoward incident was reported during their stay
in Shanghai.

                                D. Kamashita

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ...
                              S.C. REGISTRI
Section 1, Special Branch.
REPORT                        Date November 20, 1938.

Subject Arrival in Shanghai of Japanese training squadron.

Made by D.S. Komoshita        Forwarded by

The Japanese training squadron comprising warships
"Iwate" and "Yakumo" under the command of Vice-Admiral U.
Tanimoto, will arrive in Shanghai at 3 p.m. November 21.
The "Iwate," flagship of Vice-Admiral Tanimoto, will berth
at the China Merchant Steamship Company's middle wharf
(now under Japanese occupation) while the "Yakumo" will berth
at No. 1 and No. 2 buoys. They will stay in Shanghai until
3 p.m. November 25, when they will leave for Formosa.
Summary programme of the movements of Vice-Admiral Tanimoto
and cadets is as follows:-
November 21 On arrival in Shanghai Vice-Admiral Tanimoto
will exchange courtesy visits with Japanese and foreign
officials, while the cadets will be given instructions under
the direction of Vice-Admiral Oikawa, Commander-in-Chief of
the Japanese China Sea Fleet.
November 22, 23 and 24. These three days will be spent for
inspection of war zones in Shanghai and Nanking, and in the
evening of November 24 a reception will be held at the
Astor House Hotel by Vice-Admiral Oikawa in honour of officers
and cadets of the squadron.
November 25 In the morning, a reception will be held by
Vice-Admiral Tanimoto aboard the "Iwate" in honour of the
leading members of Japanese community and high officials.
In connection with the arrival of the training squadron
Lieutenant Sato of the Japanese Naval Landing Party was
communicated with and stated that at present there is no
schedule of visits by the members of the squadron to the foreign
area south of the Soochow Creek, therefore any precautionary
measures necessary will be undertaken by the Naval Landing

事由：日本练习舰队抵达上海。

制作人：D.S. Komoshita        转呈人：

由谷本（U. Tanimoto）中将指挥的包括战舰“磐手”号和“八云”号在内的日本练习舰队，将于11月21日下午3时抵达上海。谷本中将的旗舰“磐手”号将停靠在招商局中栈码头（现已被日军占领），而“八云”号将停靠在1号和2号浮筒。他们将在上海停留至11月25日下午3时，届时将启程前往台湾。
谷本中将及学员的活动概要如下：
11月21日 抵达上海后，谷本中将将与日本及外国官员进行礼节性互访，而学员将在日本中国方面舰队司令长官及川（Oikawa）中将的指导下接受指令。
11月22日、23日和24日。这三天将用于视察上海和南京的战区，11月24日晚，及川中将将在华懋饭店（Astor House Hotel）举行招待会，以欢迎该舰队的军官和学员。
11月25日 上午，谷本中将在“磐手”号上举行招待会，以欢迎日本侨民领袖和高级官员。
就练习舰队的抵达事宜，已与日本海军陆战队的佐藤（Sato）中尉取得联系，他表示目前该舰队成员没有参观苏州河以南外国区域的计划，因此任何必要的预防措施将由海军陆战队

（印：上海公共租界工部局总办处 1933年11月）
（批：D.S. Komoshita 11月26日）

S.l. Special Branch 16/4/38
REPORT    Date April 25, 19 38

Subject Proposed arrival of Japanese Training Squadron.

Made by D.S. Kamashita    Forwarded by G. Crawford. D.I.

The Japanese training ships "Yakumo" and "Iwate"
under the command of Rear-Admiral S. Takasu are scheduled
to arrive in Shanghai at 2 p.m. April 27 and will berth at
the China Merchants Company's wharfs at Broadway. The
Squadron intends staying here until April 30, when they
return to Japan.

In this connection, Sub-Lieutenant Fukuyama, acting
adjutant to the Commander of the Japanese Naval Landing
Party, was interviewed by D.S. Kamashita, when he stated
that there were no arrangements being made for the visit-
ors to visit the area south of the Soochow Creek. The
necessary precautionary measures will be taken by members
of the Japanese Naval Landing Party alone.. He further,
stated that if the necessity did arise he would communicate
with Shanghai Municipal Police immediately.

报告    日期 1938年4月25日

事由：日本训练舰队拟抵沪事宜。

呈报人：D.S. Kamashita    转呈人：督察 G. Crawford

在海军少将 S. Takasu 指挥下的日本训练舰“八云”号（Yakumo）和“岩手”号（Iwate），定于4月27日下午2时抵达上海，并将停泊于百老汇路（Broadway）的招商局码头。该舰队计划在此停留至4月30日，随后返回日本。

就此事宜，特别股警探 D.S. Kamashita 会见了日本海军陆战队指挥官的副官福山（Fukuyama）少尉。福山少尉表示，并未安排访客前往苏州河以南地区。必要的预防措施将仅由日本海军陆战队成员采取。他还表示，如有必要，他将立即与上海公共租界工部局警务处联系。
